name: dna_tools
description: DNA and RNA sequence tools: reverse complement and complement with IUPAC ambiguity codes, GC content, base counts, transcription, translation with the standard genetic code (NCBI table 1) in 1, 3 or 6 frames, open reading frame search with a minimum length in all six frames, and approximate molecular weight of single- or double-stranded molecules. Accepts FASTA, whitespace and numbering.

sequence.description: IUPAC nucleotide letters; FASTA headers, spaces and digits are ignored

min_aa.description: ORF minimum length in amino acids, stop excluded

catalog.source: NCBI translation table 1 (The Standard Code); IUPAC-IUB nucleotide ambiguity codes (Nomenclature Committee, 1985); behaviour matched to Biopython's Seq.reverse_complement, translate and gc_fraction; molecular weights after Thermo Fisher Scientific's DNA and RNA molecular weight formulas
